selected_top_5.reasoning: The world auto-scrolls continuously, the run is endless until failure, score rises over time, and the player survives by reacting to upcoming terrain.
The core action is jumping between platforms with gravity, landing detection, gap timing, and recovery through air control.
The gameplay resembles a streamlined obstacle-course run where success depends on traversing gaps and elevated surfaces in sequence.
The constant forward pressure and need for fast jump decisions create a speed-running feel, even though it is score-based rather than level-completion based.
It shares auto-forward runner pacing, but the movement is not lane-based; vertical platforming replaces discrete lane switching.
